name: Not Enough Kittens
review:
Not Enough Kittens is a 35-ways slot about a cat-obsessed professor, with double symbols and free spins with retriggers.

Thunderkick rates it Low volatility, with a 3,650x cap and a 96.1% RTP.

Double symbols count as two of a kind, which helps ways wins add up quickly. The mad-professor cat theme is pure Thunderkick whimsy, with gentle maths behind it.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
